subject: Request: Lyra-XL variant stability waiver and staggered rollout window
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Lyra-XL variant stability waiver and staggered rollout window

Hi Karthik —

We ran a cross-team smoke pass on Lyra-XL (variant: lyra-xl-v2.0) over our 8k token document suite and observed a reproducible latency and output-stability regression vs v1.2 when KV cache sizes exceed ~6M entries. Attached are the condensed smoke report and perf diff.

Context / ask:
- Product wants to onboard lyra-xl-v2.0 for feature parity (token-savings and quantization improvements) but needs a short exception to the standard pin policy to allow a staggered integration (staging-only canary) while we validate telemetry.
- Request: temporary stability waiver to NOT auto-promote the new variant into production routing for 14 days; allow canary in staging and dedicated QA lanes with pin to lyra-xl-v1.2 in prod.
- Questions we need answered before approval: compatibility test matrix results (token/seq-length edgecases), expected throughput delta, and a list of telemetry owners for alerting.

Proposed timeline:
- Canary in staging: 2026-09-06 -> 2026-09-12
- Decision checkpoint: 2026-09-13 (metrics review)

Can you confirm whether an exemption is OK, and flag any blocking concerns (Dedicated customer impact, routing compatibility)? I looped Laura and Priyom since infra and runtime telemetry will need to own the canary signals.

Attachments: lyra-xl-smoke-report.pdf, perf-diff-8k.csv

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Product Manager, Model Experience
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Lyra-XL variant stability waiver and staggered rollout window

Naomi —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick thoughts:

- I support a staging-only canary, but we need firm stop/rollback criteria defined and owners assigned. Can Priyom own the runtime signals (p99 latency, error spikes, kv-cache OOMs) and Laura own the canary runbook (rollout steps + traffic split)?
- We should avoid a blanket 14-day waiver in prod. Proposed conservative approach: 72-hour production pin to v1.2 (no promotions) while we run an extended staging canary for 7 days. If metrics look good, we do a gated 1% prod canary for 48 hours, then escalate.
- Please confirm affected customers/regions. If Dedicated customers are on route tables that would auto-select v2.0, we must ensure routing policy excludes them.

Can we do a 30-minute sync today at 3pm PT to finalize the signals and rollout doc? If helpful, I drafted a short rollout-proposal that lists the signals and rollback triggers — attaching it inline in the follow-up.

Karthik
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Lyra Support <integrations@lyra.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Lyra-XL variant stability waiver and staggered rollout window

Thanks Karthik — scheduling the sync for 3pm PT.

Answers up front:
- Affected accounts: internal QA lanes + Acme Retail (staging only). No Dedicated customers were routed to v2.0 yet; we double-checked routing policies.
- Telemetry owners: Priyom (runtime p99/error), Laura (canary ops), Naomi (product-level quality, hallucination/regression tests).
- Compatibility matrix: quick pass included tokenization parity and long-context sampling — failing cases are concentrated on large-kv-cache sequences. Full fuzz results are linked: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/ModelIntake/Lyra-XL-compatibility

Lyra Support — if you have a recommended mitigation (micro-patch or parameter fallback) for the KV cache behavior, please advise. Attaching the staging-rollout-checklist.md for the sync.

Naomi

On Mon, Aug 31, 2026 at 11:04 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Naomi —
>
> Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick thoughts:
> ...

From: Lyra Support <integrations@lyra.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 14:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Lyra-XL variant stability waiver and staggered rollout window

Hi Naomi / Karthik / Priyom —

Thanks for the report and perf diffs. We reproduced the KV-cache growth pattern in our internal tests. Immediate mitigations we can push:

1) A micro-patch (v2.0.1) that changes the cache eviction threshold behavior. This should reduce high-watermark growth in long sessions but may slightly increase average latency (~3-5%).
2) A parameter fallback (control plane knob) that forces the older cache policy per-route until telemetry clears it.

We can publish v2.0.1 to your staging repo by EOD and provide a small test payload set. Link to artifact (s3 stub): s3://lyra-artifacts/lyra-xl/v2.0.1/manifest.json

Let us know which path you prefer. We recommend the parameter fallback for a faster mitigation while we validate v2.0.1.

Best,
Lyra Integrations Team
integrations@lyra.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Decision: temporary staging-only waiver + production pin-for-72h; actions and owners

Summary / decision: after the sync and Lyra's response, we will approve a limited waiver following the guardrails below:

- Staging canary: lyra-xl-v2.0 (or v2.0.1 if Lyra publishes) from 2026-09-06 -> 2026-09-12.
- Production: pin to lyra-xl-v1.2 for 72 hours from the date of any attempted promotion; no automatic promotions during the staging canary.
- If staging metrics are within thresholds (p99 latency <= baseline+10%, no >=3 sigma error spikes, KV-cache growth bounded), we will run a 1% prod canary for 48 hours.
- Rollback triggers: sustained p99 > baseline+15% for 30 minutes, any customer-facing error spike > 1% of requests, or reproduced OOMs.

Owners / next steps:
- Priyom Das: own runtime signals and alerting, configure the control-plane knob to exclude Dedicated routes. (due: 2026-09-04)
- Laura Bennett: finalize staging rollout runbook and verify playbooks are reachable. (due: 2026-09-04)
- Naomi Feldman: coordinate with Lyra and confirm v2.0.1 staging artifact availability. (due: 2026-09-03)
- Karthik: approval and oversight, will sign-off post metrics review.

Attachments: staging-rollout-checklist.md (actionable playbook), lyra-xl-smoke-report.pdf, perf-diff-8k.csv

If no objections by 09:00 AM PT on 2026-09-03, we proceed with the plan above.

Karthik
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
